paragraphs.text: Cards from Apocalypse compared to cards from earlier sets .
Battlefield Forge is strictly better than Scabland .
Caves of Koilos is strictly better than Salt Flats .
Llanowar Wastes is strictly better than Pine Barrens .
Shivan Reef is strictly better than Caldera Lake .
Yavimaya Coast is strictly better than Skyshroud Forest .
Dodecapod is strictly better than Sand Golem .
Penumbra Wurm is strictly better than Rootbreaker Wurm .
Night // Day is strictly better than Warrior's Honor , Warrior's Charge , and Virtuous Charge .
